(a) a monolithic pixel detector with 50 µm thick active layer and a pixel size of 20 µm × 20 µm can be built with the 0.18 µm CMOS process used for the CAP4 chip, (b) the readout speed of a 5-deepsense pipeline can be increased to > 100 kHz with a digital design, (c) a digital design can be used to improve signal stability by reducing the number of analog components

a 1.8 V supply voltage is sufficient for a MAPS design with a 1 GHz readout bandwidth and 50µm thick sensor layer.
